lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Everybody made a list. The "last day" list.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Kids spent the Robux they'd been saving for years.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Every server was full. Every obby had a line. One obby had a line... for the line.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: One guy finally read the Terms of Service. All of them. [pause] It took eleven hours. He said the ending was disappointing.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Even our math teacher canceled the test... so he could finish his tycoon.

lines.speaker: STREAMER
lines.text: [hyped, screaming] Chat! This is the last stream EVER! I will not blink! I will not sleep! [pause] I will not... [yawns] ...okay, maybe one nap.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [serious, emotional] Kids. Sit down. I need to tell you something.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [ashamed] I'm level nine hundred... in a fishing game.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [shocked] Dad! You said video games rot your brain!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [defensive] It's not a game! It's RELAXING! [voice cracking] And tonight... I was finally going to catch the Golden Fish!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: Even Mom had a list.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [deadpan] She said she was taking a bath. [pause] For six hours.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [stressed] I have every badge in Roblox... except one. The secret one. The "Touch Grass" badge.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [frustrated] Nobody knows how to get it! I searched every map! Every cave! Every... grass texture!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [sad, tiny] Goodbye, Mister Elevator Man. You were the best elevator man.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: [sad, small] Ding. [pause] Ding. [pause] ...Ding.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [determined] And me? I had one thing on my list. Finish Bubble Island. Before the world forgot it ever existed.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [confused] Juno... I just fell through the whole world.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [quickly] That's not a bug. That's... the secret underwater level.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.text: [deadpan] There's no water. It's just grey. Forever.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.text: [defeated] ...It's a very secret level.
